intro: Caleb Williams and the Bears beat the Lions 39-35 on a touchdown with three seconds left, and the Bills took the Chiefs 13-10 on a 57-yard field goal as time expired. Drake Maye's broken fibula leaves New England with Tommy DeVito, and Denver visits Pittsburgh today in the Black Friday game. 160 stories across all 32 teams.

top.label: Biggest Story
top.headline: Bears beat the Lions 39-35 on Odunze's touchdown with three seconds left
top.dek: Chicago won on Thanksgiving in Detroit and moved to 9-2, alone in first place in the NFC North. Caleb Williams threw for 345 yards and two scores in the win.

top.label: Injury Watch
top.headline: Drake Maye's fractured fibula puts Tommy DeVito in charge in New England
top.dek: The Patriots quarterback is expected to miss at least six weeks. New England is sticking with DeVito as its starter, beginning Sunday at the Chargers.

top.label: Player Spotlight
top.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs runs for 205 yards and three touchdowns in a Lions loss
top.dek: Detroit's back piled up the yards against Chicago on Thanksgiving and still came up four points short. It was the kind of day that gets noticed in the record books even in a defeat.

top.label: Stat of the Day
top.headline: 57: yards on Tyler Bass's field goal that beat the Chiefs as time expired
top.dek: Buffalo won 13-10 on Thursday night and moved to 10-1. Josh Allen threw for just 81 yards, and the Bills still got the win.

top.label: What's Next
top.headline: Broncos visit the Steelers today with Mason Rudolph starting
top.dek: Denver plays at Pittsburgh at 3 p.m. ET on Prime Video without suspended running back J.K. Dobbins. A win keeps the Broncos in the hunt for the AFC's No. 2 seed.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.headline: Bass boots Bills past Chiefs at the horn

stories.text: Bass hits a 57-yarder to beat Kansas City 13-10
stories.summary: Tyler Bass kicked a 57-yard field goal as time expired on Thanksgiving night to give Buffalo a 13-10 win over the Chiefs. A blocked punt put the Bills in range after an offense that stalled all night. Buffalo is 10-1 and has won seven straight.

stories.text: Kincaid plays through thumb and ankle injuries
stories.summary: Tight end Dalton Kincaid went into Thanksgiving night questionable with thumb and ankle injuries and was active after missing the win over Miami. Cornerback Christian Benford was inactive with a groin injury for the second straight game. I found no postgame injury report, so check Monday for updates before the Patriots game.

stories.text: Tyler Bass wins it from 57 yards out
stories.summary: Bass made the kick from 57 yards with no time left. A blocked punt had shortened the field for a Bills offense that struggled all night, and Kansas City's punting problems handed Buffalo its best field position.

stories.text: 81: Josh Allen's passing yards on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Allen finished 10 of 21 for 81 yards against Kansas City, and the Bills still won. Two of his drives started in Chiefs territory and ended without points. Four days earlier he threw for 304 yards against Miami.

stories.text: Bills visit the Patriots on Dec. 6
stories.summary: Buffalo is done for Week 12 and next plays at New England on Sunday, Dec. 6 at 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS. The Patriots will likely still be without quarterback Drake Maye. Watch whether Allen's offense fixes its red zone trouble.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.headline: Youngest roster hits the rookie wall

stories.text: Miami leans on rookies as the season runs long
stories.summary: The Dolphins own the NFL's youngest roster and could play as many as 14 rookies against the Jets. Coach Jeff Hafley says he is watching for the rookie wall, since many of these players have not stopped since their college seasons ended. Miami is 1-9.

stories.text: Willis stays on IR, five Dolphins questionable
stories.summary: Quarterback Malik Willis and safety Ronnie Harrison Jr. are on injured reserve. JuJu Brents, Jared Wayne, Bradley Pinion, Jaylin Simpson and Dante Trader Jr. are listed as questionable for Sunday. Kyle McCord remains the starter.

stories.text: Jacob Rodriguez keeps piling up tackles
stories.summary: Linebacker Jacob Rodriguez led Miami with 13 tackles against Buffalo and intercepted Josh Allen. He has 93 tackles, seventh in the NFL, plus two interceptions, a sack and a forced fumble.

stories.text: 185: Miami's total yards in a 26-9 loss to Buffalo
stories.summary: The Dolphins managed 185 yards and 10 first downs, and all nine points came on field goals. McCord went 12 of 33 for 102 yards with an interception in his second career start.

stories.text: Jets visit Miami on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Miami hosts the Jets at Hard Rock Stadium on CBS. The Dolphins won the first meeting 28-25 on Oct. 25 and have won seven of the last eight in the series. They play at Denver in Week 13.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.headline: DeVito starts with Maye out at least six weeks

stories.text: Maye's broken fibula puts DeVito in charge
stories.summary: Drake Maye fractured his fibula in the loss to Detroit in Munich. Coach Mike Vrabel said Tommy DeVito is the starter, and the team has not ruled out adding another quarterback. Only DeVito and rookie Behren Morton are available on the roster.

stories.text: Maye expected out at least six weeks
stories.summary: NFL Media reports Maye will miss at least six weeks. The Patriots kept him on the active roster rather than injured reserve, and coach Mike Vrabel called the situation fluid. Backup Tommy DeVito and rookie Behren Morton are the only quarterbacks available.

stories.text: Elijah Ponder leads the New England pass rush
stories.summary: Ponder has 8 tackles for loss and 7.5 sacks. New England needs that pressure against a Chargers line facing an offense that has been sacked an NFL-high 39 times.

stories.text: 32.3: points the Patriots allow per game over four weeks
stories.summary: New England's defense ranks 30th in EPA per play and has given up 32.3 points a game over its last four. The Patriots also hold a minus-10 turnover differential, tied for 31st.

stories.text: Patriots at Chargers, Sunday 4:05 p.m. ET
stories.summary: New England plays at SoFi Stadium on CBS. Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol, so DJ Uiagalelei could make his first NFL start. Buffalo visits Foxborough on Dec. 6.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.headline: Jets snap skid, now face Miami

stories.text: Jets end five-game skid with 27-24 win in L.A.
stories.summary: New York scored on its first five possessions and held on to beat the Chargers. Geno Smith threw three touchdown passes, and Breece Hall ran 20 times for 86 yards. The Jets now try to avoid a season sweep by Miami.

stories.text: Williams, Cooper, Wallace questionable for Miami
stories.summary: Isaiah Williams, Omar Cooper Jr. and Trevin Wallace are listed as questionable. Williams and Cooper sat out the Chargers game, and Sterling Shepard filled in from the practice squad to catch two touchdowns.

stories.text: David Bailey is closing in on the rookie sack record
stories.summary: The No. 2 overall pick has 9.5 sacks, third in the league and half a sack short of the Jets rookie record. He is the first player since 1982 with at least 9.5 sacks and six forced fumbles through 10 career games.

stories.text: 9 of 11: Jets third-down conversions against L.A.
stories.summary: New York converted nine of 11 third downs in the win over the Chargers. Smith went 17 of 21 for 176 yards with no turnovers, and the Jets ran the ball well behind Hall and Braelon Allen, who had 75 yards.

stories.text: Jets at Dolphins, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Jets play at Hard Rock Stadium and want to avoid a sweep after losing the first meeting 28-25 on Oct. 25. They have a bye in Week 13. Watch whether Frank Reich keeps calling plays from the sideline.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.headline: Ravens lose a shootout, skid hits six

stories.text: Ravens drop a 35-33 shootout in Carolina, losing streak reaches six
stories.summary: Baltimore gained 421 yards at Bank of America Stadium on Nov. 22 and still fell to 4-7 when Carolina scored 35. Jacoby Brissett threw for 276 yards and a touchdown but also gave the ball away once. Lamar Jackson has been out since Week 8, and the playoff picture looks bleak.

stories.text: Derrick Henry cleared a concussion scare, Jackson stays on IR
stories.summary: ESPN's game preview lists both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley on injured reserve. Derrick Henry spent time in the concussion protocol, and coach Jesse Minter expects him to play Sunday in Houston. Jackson's broken and dislocated thumb came with a 6 to 10 week healing estimate from Minter on Nov. 13.

stories.text: Zay Flowers piles up 97 yards as Brissett's top target
stories.summary: Flowers caught 8 passes for 97 yards against Carolina, his longest a 26-yarder. Rashod Bateman needed only 2 catches to reach 67 yards, including a 52-yard touchdown. Derrick Henry added 94 rushing yards and a score on 13 carries.

stories.text: 421: Ravens outgained Carolina and still lost
stories.summary: Baltimore finished with 421 net yards to Carolina's 378 and held a 5-penalty, 41-yard edge in flags. Chuba Hubbard's 120 rushing yards and two scores helped Carolina win anyway. Carolina held the ball for 31:52 to Baltimore's 28:08.

stories.text: Ravens try to end a six-game skid at Houston
stories.summary: Baltimore (4-7) visits Houston (4-6) on Sunday, Nov. 29 on CBS, with the AP preview listing a 1 p.m. ET start. Henry has 793 rushing yards, seventh in the NFL, and the Texans have Will Anderson Jr., who leads the league with 11.5 sacks. Houston beat Baltimore 44-10 in their last meeting.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.headline: Bengals regroup after last-second loss

stories.text: Late field goal sinks Bengals in Washington, 22-20
stories.summary: Evan McPherson's 56-yard field goal put Cincinnati up 20-19 with 46 seconds left on Monday night. Jayden Daniels then hit two deep passes, and Drew Stevens kicked a 26-yarder as time expired. The loss ended a five-game winning streak, but the Bengals still lead the AFC North by a game.

stories.text: Burks heads to injured reserve, Iosivas set to return
stories.summary: Linebacker Oren Burks went on the reserve/injured list with a groin injury after the Washington game. Linebacker Swayze Bozeman and guard Brian Parker II were activated from the list. Receiver Andrei Iosivas, out with a thumb injury, is expected back for Week 12.

stories.text: Boye Mafe racks up three first-half sacks
stories.summary: Mafe finished with 5 tackles and 3 sacks, all before halftime. He is the first Bengal with three sacks in a game since Trey Hendrickson in 2024 and now leads the team with 9.5 on the year. Dexter Lawrence added a career-high 10 tackles for loss.

stories.text: 8: Burrow's straight games at 70 percent or better
stories.summary: Joe Burrow went 28 of 40 for 300 yards and 2 touchdowns in Washington, his eighth game in a row completing at least 70 percent. That ties the NFL record shared by Joe Montana and Tua Tagovailoa. His 3,095 passing yards lead the league through 11 weeks.

stories.text: Bengals host the 3-7 Saints on Sunday
stories.summary: Cincinnati (7-3) welcomes New Orleans (3-7) to Paycor Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1 p.m. ET, with the Saints' site listing CBS. Burrow said the Bengals had chances to win Monday and praised the Saints' blitzing linebackers. Washington held Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins to 74 yards combined.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.headline: Browns land first Sunday night game since 2021

stories.text: Browns get Sunday Night Football for the first time since 2021
stories.summary: The league flexed Cleveland's home game against Las Vegas into the Sunday night slot. It ends the NFL's longest Sunday Night Football drought for any team, dating to Nov. 28, 2021. The Browns hold the final AFC playoff spot at 6-4.

stories.text: Four Browns sit out Wednesday's practice
stories.summary: Right guard Austin Barber (knee), receiver Denzel Boston (quadriceps) and defensive ends Isaiah McGuire (calf) and Derek Barnett (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday. Five more players were limited, among them center Elgton Jenkins (knee) and tight end Harold Fannin Jr. (groin). Safety Ronnie Hickman, who has a concussion on the report, practiced fully.

stories.text: Deshaun Watson says shoulder and Achilles are fully back
stories.summary: Watson threw for 308 yards at Tennessee, 324 at Pittsburgh and 312 against Houston, after topping out at 268 in his first six starts. He ran for 49 yards and a touchdown on 8 carries against the Texans, his best rushing day this season. He has no touchdown passes in his last four starts.

stories.text: 78: points Cleveland's defense has allowed in the first quarter
stories.summary: Opponents have scored 78 first-quarter points on the Browns, against 39 in the second, 33 in the third and 63 in the fourth. They scored on their first possession in 8 of 10 games. Jacksonville opened the season with a 31-0 lead.

stories.text: Raiders visit Cleveland on Sunday night
stories.summary: Cleveland (6-4) hosts Las Vegas (4-7) at Huntington Bank Field on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC. The Raiders start rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 pick in the draft. Brock Bowers (ankle) was limited at Wednesday's practice for Las Vegas.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.headline: Steelers cut Rodgers, Rudolph starts today

stories.text: Steelers waive Aaron Rodgers after sideline feud goes public
stories.summary: Pittsburgh benched Rodgers Tuesday night, then waived him after his appearance on The Pat McAfee Show, where he criticized coach Mike McCarthy. McCarthy had said a day earlier that Rodgers was the quarterback. Mason Rudolph starts Friday against Denver for a 6-4 team that has lost two straight.

stories.text: Highsmith out, Holcomb questionable against Denver
stories.summary: Outside linebacker Alex Highsmith (ankle) is out, along with receiver Ben Skowronek (calf) and guard Gennings Dunker (knee), both on injured reserve. Inside linebacker Cole Holcomb (heel) is questionable after two limited practices. Receiver Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) and Cameron Heyward (rest) carried no game designation.

stories.text: Mason Rudolph gets the start on short notice
stories.summary: The Steelers announced the change after 11 p.m. ET Tuesday, which left Rudolph only days to prepare for a Denver team that is 8-2. No 2026 passing numbers for him were available in the sources reviewed. Rodgers was ruled inactive for a non-injury reason.

stories.text: 20-14-1: Denver's all-time edge over Pittsburgh
stories.summary: The Broncos lead the series 20-14-1, playoffs included. Pittsburgh won the last meeting 13-6 in Denver in 2024. Denver's defense led the league with 68 sacks last season.

stories.text: Steelers host Broncos on Black Friday
stories.summary: Pittsburgh plays Denver today at 3 p.m. ET at Acrisure Stadium, streaming on Amazon Prime Video. Pittsburgh holds the No. 7 seed in the AFC with a 6-4 record.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.headline: Texans ride Colts rout into Ravens game

stories.text: Texans beat Colts 26-3, now eye a Ravens team in free fall
stories.summary: Houston is 4-6 and sits three games behind Jacksonville in the AFC South. C.J. Stroud went 21 of 27 for 194 yards and three touchdowns in the win over Indianapolis. Baltimore arrives at 4-7 after six straight losses.

stories.text: Hunter, Boutte and Rutledge sit out practice again
stories.summary: Danielle Hunter (hamstring), Kayshon Boutte (hip), Brevin Jordan (finger and foot) and Keylan Rutledge (neck and shoulder) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday. Sheldon Rankins (ankle) was limited Thursday. Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) went full after a limited Wednesday.

stories.text: Will Anderson Jr. leads the league in sacks
stories.summary: Anderson tops the NFL sack chart, and Houston's defense ranks third in the league in sacks as a team. He gets a Baltimore offense that has allowed 27 sacks this season.

stories.text: 4: C.J. Stroud's interceptions all season
stories.summary: Stroud has thrown four interceptions this year, and Houston has the fewest giveaways in the NFL. Last year against Baltimore he went 23 of 27 for 244 yards and four touchdowns in a 44-10 Texans win.

stories.text: Ravens visit Houston on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Baltimore has Jacoby Brissett at quarterback, and he is 0-2 as a starter with 616 passing yards. Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve. Watch the Houston pass rush against a line that gives up sacks.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.headline: Colts waive Jones, hand keys to Richardson

stories.text: Colts waive Daniel Jones, Anthony Richardson Sr. starts Sunday
stories.summary: Indianapolis cut Jones a day after a 26-3 loss to Houston. Coach Shane Steichen said many factors led to the move and that Richardson, who has not started since Week 16 of 2024, has matured in his preparation. The Colts are 3-8 with six games left.

stories.text: Rookie end Caden Curry out for season with torn wrist ligament
stories.summary: Curry hurt his wrist in the loss to Houston, had surgery and went on injured reserve Tuesday. He finished with 26 tackles and one sack in 11 games. Sauce Gardner (calf) and Bernhard Raimann (concussion) returned to full practice Wednesday.

stories.text: Richardson gets first start in nearly two years
stories.summary: The No. 4 pick in 2023 spent the past two seasons as Jones's backup. Steichen pointed to his athleticism and running ability and said a full week of practice as the starter should help. Riley Leonard is the third quarterback.

stories.text: 13: interceptions Jones threw, most in the NFL
stories.summary: Jones also ranked last in the league with a 65.4 passer rating when the Colts released him. The offense averages 19.2 points per game, seventh lowest in the NFL.

stories.text: Giants visit Indianapolis Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Richardson makes his first start of the year, and the Colts have lost six of their last seven. Watch how the offense uses his legs.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.headline: Jaguars need a response after Giants loss

stories.text: Jaguars drop 23-18 to Giants, still lead the AFC South
stories.summary: Jacksonville went one for six on touchdowns in the red zone and settled for four Cam Little field goals. The Giants held the offense to 238 yards and three second-half points. The Jaguars still lead Houston by three games.

stories.text: Hainsey week to week, Tuten playing through ankle issue
stories.summary: Center Robert Hainsey has a knee injury and missed the Giants game, so Jonah Monheim started. Running back Bhayshul Tuten has missed practice time every week since Week 8 but has not missed a game. Left tackle Anton Harrison is out for the season.

stories.text: Lawrence struggles under pressure against New York
stories.summary: Trevor Lawrence went 25 of 47 for 301 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions against the Giants. Defenders pressured him on 46.2 percent of dropbacks. Against Tennessee two weeks earlier he threw for 352 yards and three touchdowns.

stories.text: 5-1: Jaguars' record after losses under Coach Coen
stories.summary: Jacksonville has bounced back well under Coach Coen and has not lost a regular-season home game since Week 6 of last season. The run game is the concern, with a season-low 77 yards twice in recent weeks.

stories.text: Titans visit Jacksonville Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: The Jaguars won the first meeting 40-23 in Nashville. Tennessee wide receiver Carnell Tate is back after missing that game. Jacksonville wants to get its ground game going at EverBank Stadium.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.headline: Cam Ward finds his rhythm on a 1-9 team

stories.text: Cam Ward makes his case as the Titans' long-term quarterback
stories.summary: Ward threw for at least 230 yards and two touchdowns in three straight games, a first for a Titans passer since Marcus Mariota in 2016. Coach Robert Saleh said Ward is showing he can lead the franchise. Tennessee lost 51-30 at Dallas on Sunday.

stories.text: Titans line thin: Skoronski on IR, Moore hurt knee
stories.summary: Left guard Peter Skoronski is on injured reserve and rookie right guard Fernando Carmona likely stays out. Left tackle Dan Moore Jr. missed Wednesday practice with a knee injury, and James Hudson III would start if Moore cannot go.

stories.text: Carnell Tate scores on a 59-yard catch and run in Dallas
stories.summary: Tate turned a short catch into a 59-yard touchdown, running 51 yards after the catch. He returns this week after missing the first Jacksonville game. Ward calls on him as a deep threat.

stories.text: 109-16: Tennessee's second-quarter scoring margin against it
stories.summary: Opponents have outscored the Titans 109-16 in the second quarter this season. Tennessee has the worst first-half scoring margin in the NFL at minus 87.

stories.text: Titans visit Jacksonville Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Tennessee has lost five straight to the Jaguars, including a 40-23 defeat in Nashville in Week 10. The defense has allowed 36, 40 and 51 points over its last three games. Watch whether Ward keeps his streak alive.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.headline: Broncos play Black Friday without Dobbins

stories.text: Payton suspends Dobbins for Black Friday trip to Pittsburgh
stories.summary: Sean Payton announced Tuesday that running back J.K. Dobbins will miss the game at Pittsburgh for conduct detrimental to the team. Dobbins left the facility after showing up that day, and Payton declined to explain further. ESPN notes he is believed to be the first Broncos player suspended midseason for that reason since Brandon Marshall in 2009.

stories.text: Three Broncos ruled out for the Steelers game
stories.summary: Denver's final report lists defensive lineman Sai'Vion Jones (hamstring), safety Taylor Rapp (quadriceps) and tight end Caleb Lohner (foot) as out. Running back Tyler Badie (thumb) is questionable and still on injured reserve. Denver also lost Dobbins to suspension, which thins the backfield further.

stories.text: Rookie Jonah Coleman earns AFC Offensive Player of the Week
stories.summary: Coleman ran 24 times for 111 yards and three touchdowns in the win over Las Vegas, plus four catches for 18 yards. The fourth-round pick is the first Broncos offensive player honored this season. Payton is watching his workload on a short week.

stories.text: 38: points Denver put on the Raiders last Sunday
stories.summary: The Broncos beat Las Vegas 38-24 in their last game and sit 8-2 overall, 4-1 in the AFC and 3-2 on the road. They now head to a Steelers team that is 4-0 at home.

stories.text: Broncos at Steelers today, 3 p.m. ET on Prime Video
stories.summary: Denver visits Acrisure Stadium on Black Friday against a 6-4 Pittsburgh team that waived Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday and will start Mason Rudolph. Rain and wind are in the forecast. Watch how Denver splits carries between Coleman and Badie.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.headline: Bills beat Chiefs on last-second field goal

stories.text: Tyler Bass kicks Bills past Chiefs as time expires
stories.summary: Buffalo won on a 57-yard Bass field goal at the gun, 13-10, in a rainy Thanksgiving night game. Patrick Mahomes threw for 174 yards and no touchdowns. A tipped punt gave the Bills a short field, and Kansas City managed five three-and-outs.

stories.text: Kenneth Walker out a third straight game with groin strain
stories.summary: ESPN reports Walker has a grade-two groin strain from the Nov. 8 game against the Jets, and the Chiefs held him out on the short week. Guard Trey Smith is expected back, while tackle Jaylon Moore (ankle) was out.

stories.text: Emmett Johnson carries the load again in Walker's place
stories.summary: The rookie started and ran 17 times for 72 yards and a second-quarter touchdown against Buffalo. Travis Kelce added four catches for 71 yards and passed 1,300 career receptions.

stories.text: 8 of 16: Butker's field goals from 40 yards or longer
stories.summary: Harrison Butker missed a 46-yarder wide right with about six minutes left, with the Chiefs trailing. He now has eight misses this season and a field goal rate just over 65 percent.

stories.text: Chiefs at Rams on Thursday night, Dec. 3
stories.summary: Kansas City plays at SoFi Stadium on Prime Video, 8:15 p.m. ET, on another short week. Andy Reid said after the loss he will make no decision on Butker yet, so watch the kicker spot.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.headline: Mendoza and Raiders head to Cleveland on SNF

stories.text: Rookie Mendoza gets a Sunday night stage in Cleveland
stories.summary: The Raiders visit the Browns on Sunday Night Football after Denver beat them 38-24. Maxx Crosby told reporters the No. 1 pick is the same guy every day and puts the work first. NBC's playoff picture says the rest of Las Vegas's season is about developing Mendoza.

stories.text: Bowers limited again, two defensive tackles sit out
stories.summary: Tight end Brock Bowers (ankle) was limited Wednesday and Thursday after missing the Denver game. Defensive tackles Adam Butler (concussion) and Tim Keenan (knee) did not practice either day. Tonka Hemingway (stinger) went from limited to out of practice Thursday.

stories.text: Mendoza throws three touchdowns in loss to Denver
stories.summary: The rookie went 18 of 37 for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception, an 88.5 passer rating. Browns defensive coordinator Mike Rutenberg praised his ability to make plays with his arm and his legs.

stories.text: 38: points Las Vegas allowed to Denver
stories.summary: The Raiders lost 38-24 in their last game. Cleveland has a lead runner in Quinshon Judkins with 423 rushing yards and four touchdowns in nine games, and the Raiders have struggled against the run all year.

stories.text: Raiders at Browns, Sunday night, 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC
stories.summary: The game was flexed into the Sunday night slot. Cleveland is 6-4 and several Browns starters are listed on the injury report, including receiver Denzel Boston (quad). Watch whether the Raiders can slow Judkins.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.headline: Herbert in concussion protocol before Patriots

stories.text: Justin Herbert enters concussion protocol
stories.summary: Jim Harbaugh confirmed Herbert reported symptoms after the Week 11 loss to the Jets and must clear every protocol step. DJ Uiagalelei is next up, and the team plans to promote Jake Browning from the practice squad. The Chargers are 1-9.

stories.text: Four Chargers watched after Jets loss
stories.summary: Running back Keaton Mitchell (knee) played four snaps, and edge rusher Akheem Mesidor (ankle) left in the second quarter. Linebacker Daiyan Henley (knee) did not practice and Tarheeb Still missed the game. Harbaugh said all depend on treatment this week.

stories.text: Omarion Hampton runs for 105 in the lone win
stories.summary: In the Week 10 win over Baltimore, Hampton carried 22 times for 105 yards and a touchdown. The line helped the team run for a season-high yardage and the defense bottled up Derrick Henry.

stories.text: 160: Chargers rushing yards, a season high
stories.summary: Los Angeles set its best rushing day of the year in the Week 10 win over the Ravens. The team's only win of the season came with a run game and a defense that Harbaugh called a heck of a run wall.

stories.text: Patriots at Chargers, Sunday 4:05 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: New England visits SoFi Stadium for the Week 12 game, which the NFL moved off Sunday night. Whether Herbert, Uiagalelei or Browning starts is the main question.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.headline: 38 points, still a Thanksgiving collapse

stories.text: Cowboys blow a 21-point lead and lose 39-38 on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Dallas led 31-10 in the third quarter and lost to Philadelphia on a 59-yard Jake Elliott field goal with two seconds left. The Eagles scored the final 15 points of the game. The loss leaves the Cowboys chasing the division leading Giants.

stories.text: Quinnen Williams leaves a play hurt in the third quarter
stories.summary: The Eagles live blog logged Quinnen Williams as injured on a third quarter play against Philadelphia. It gave no diagnosis and no return status, so his availability for the Seattle trip is unknown. Watch the first practice report next week.

stories.text: Javonte Williams scores three times in a loss
stories.summary: Williams carried 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns, then added a receiving touchdown. Dak Prescott went 19 of 28 for 291 yards, two touchdowns and an interception. CeeDee Lamb caught seven passes for 134 yards.

stories.text: 38: points Dallas scored and still lost
stories.summary: The Cowboys scored 38 against the Eagles and lost by one. They also led by 21 points. Philadelphia's comeback from that deficit is the largest in Thanksgiving history.

stories.text: Cowboys head to Seattle on Monday night, Dec. 7
stories.summary: Dallas plays at the Seahawks on Monday, Dec. 7 at 7:15 p.m. ET on ESPN. The Cowboys then take their bye in Week 14. They have a quick turnaround from a one-point loss, so watch how the defense closes games.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.headline: Giants lead the East heading to Indy

stories.text: Giants beat Jaguars 23-18 and hold the division lead
stories.summary: New York improved to 6-3-1 with a win over Jacksonville at MetLife Stadium. The Giants gained only 238 yards but forced two turnovers. Their defense carried the day.

stories.text: Abdul Carter day-to-day with ankle and calf issues
stories.summary: Carter did not practice Wednesday. Coach John Harbaugh said he should be fine for the game. Shelby Harris and Dru Phillips also sat out with illness, and Isaiah Likely (groin) and Arvell Reese (back) were limited.

stories.text: Abdul Carter earns NFC Defensive Player of the Week
stories.summary: Carter had two sacks, five quarterback hits and four tackles against Jacksonville. Next Gen Stats credited him with 12 pressures. He now has four sacks and 13 quarterback hits this season.

stories.text: 238: yards the Giants needed to beat Jacksonville
stories.summary: Jacksonville out-gained New York 354 to 238. The Jaguars committed two turnovers to the Giants' one. J.J. McCarthy threw for 173 yards and a touchdown, and Malik Nabers caught seven passes for 55 yards and a score.

stories.text: Giants visit the 3-8 Colts on Sunday
stories.summary: New York plays at Indianapolis on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1 p.m. ET on FOX. The Colts are 3-8. A road win keeps the Giants ahead in the NFC East before San Francisco visits MetLife in Week 13.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.headline: Eagles rally from 21 down in Dallas

stories.text: Elliott's 59-yarder sinks Dallas, 39-38
stories.summary: Philadelphia trailed 31-10 in the third quarter and won on a Jake Elliott field goal with two seconds left. The Eagles scored 22 points in the fourth quarter. It is the largest comeback in Thanksgiving history and moves them to 4-7.

stories.text: Cooper DeJean and Dallas Goedert leave with injuries
stories.summary: The Eagles live blog listed cornerback Cooper DeJean as ruled out after the opening drive and tight end Dallas Goedert as ruled out after he left hurt. Saquon Barkley was treated for a stinger and listed as questionable to return. No final statuses were posted.

stories.text: DeVonta Smith posts a career-high 200 yards
stories.summary: Smith caught 11 passes for 200 yards and two touchdowns from Joe Milton. Milton finished 21 of 31 for 331 yards and three touchdown passes, plus a rushing score.

stories.text: 7-1: Eagles on Thanksgiving since 1939
stories.summary: Philadelphia improved to 7-1 on Thanksgiving in its history. This one came after a 21-point deficit.

stories.text: Eagles travel to Arizona on Dec. 6
stories.summary: Philadelphia plays at the Cardinals on Sunday, Dec. 6 at 4:05 p.m. ET on FOX. The Eagles then host Indianapolis in Week 14. Watch the injury report for DeJean, Goedert and Barkley.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.headline: Commanders edge Bengals, now visit Arizona

stories.text: Commanders beat Bengals 22-20 on Monday night
stories.summary: Washington won at Northwest Stadium to move to 4-5-1 and handed Cincinnati a loss that cost it ground in the AFC North. The Commanders trailed 17-10 in the third quarter before coming back.

stories.text: Jayden Daniels full on Wednesday despite sore left hand
stories.summary: Daniels went full with left elbow and left hand listings. Coach Dan Quinn said the non-throwing hand was swollen after a scramble but did not limit him. Cornerback Amik Robertson (ankle) did not practice.

stories.text: Boye Mafe piles up three sacks
stories.summary: Mafe set a career high with three sacks against Cincinnati. Antonio Williams also set a career high with nine catches.

stories.text: 982: Stefon Diggs ties Randy Moss on the receptions list
stories.summary: Diggs moved into a tie with Moss for 19th on the NFL career receptions list with 982. Chig Okonkwo caught four of five targets for 66 yards.

stories.text: Commanders play at Arizona on Sunday
stories.summary: Washington visits the Cardinals on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX. Arizona quarterback Carson Beck is day-to-day with a back injury, and Josh Johnson is preparing to start if needed. Washington then travels to Tennessee in Week 13.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.headline: Odunze wins it at the gun, Bears take the North

stories.text: Bears steal Thanksgiving in Detroit and take over the NFC North
stories.summary: Chicago trailed for most of the afternoon, then Caleb Williams found Rome Odunze for a 6-yard touchdown with three seconds left to beat Detroit 39-35. The win moved the Bears to 9-2 and into sole possession of first place in the division.

stories.text: Loveland leaves with a knee injury, Kmet already out
stories.summary: Rookie tight end Colston Loveland hurt his knee in the first quarter and did not return. The Bears were already without Cole Kmet, who is out for the season with his own knee injury, so the tight end room is thin heading into December.

stories.text: Williams throws for 345 yards and two scores in Detroit
stories.summary: Caleb Williams went 30 of 44 for 345 yards and two touchdowns without an interception, and he added 15 yards on three carries. Odunze caught six passes for 87 yards and two touchdowns, including the winner. D'Andre Swift had seven catches for 97 yards.

stories.text: 39: points the Bears scored in the win at Detroit
stories.summary: Chicago put up 39 at Ford Field and still needed every one of them, because Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 205 yards and three touchdowns for the Lions. The Bears are 1-2 in the division and 7-2 in the conference.

stories.text: Jaguars visit Soldier Field on Dec. 6
stories.summary: Chicago hosts Jacksonville on Sunday, Dec. 6 at 1 p.m. ET. Watch the tight end snaps without Loveland and Kmet. The Bears meet the Lions again at Soldier Field on Jan. 3.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.headline: Gibbs runs for 205, Lions lose it at the buzzer

stories.text: Lions fall 39-35 after Bears score with three seconds left
stories.summary: Detroit lost for the first time in seven games and dropped to 8-3, a game behind Chicago in the NFC North. The Lions had the Bears down for most of the day before Williams and Odunze connected on the last play that mattered.

stories.text: Hutchinson done for the year, defense stays thin
stories.summary: Edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson was hurt in Week 10 while celebrating a sack and is out for the rest of the season. NFL.com also notes Detroit lost Jack Campbell earlier this month, which left the defense short against Chicago's passing attack.

stories.text: Gibbs runs for 205 yards and three touchdowns
stories.summary: Jahmyr Gibbs carried 21 times for 205 yards and three scores and caught five passes in a losing effort. The touchdowns were his 16th, 17th and 18th of the season. Newsweek, citing ESPN Insights, says he passed Barry Sanders for the most rushing touchdowns before age 25.

stories.text: 146: Amon-Ra St. Brown's receiving yards on seven catches
stories.summary: St. Brown led the Lions through the air while Jared Goff went 25 of 36 for 313 yards, one touchdown and one interception. Jameson Williams added six catches for 68 yards.

stories.text: Lions travel to Atlanta on Dec. 6
stories.summary: Detroit visits the Falcons on Sunday, Dec. 6 at 1 p.m. ET. The Lions then close out a rematch with the Bears at Soldier Field on Jan. 3, which could decide the North.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.headline: Rams run over Packers on Thanksgiving Eve

stories.text: Packers lose 26-13 to the Rams, their second straight
stories.summary: Green Bay fell to 6-5 in the first Thanksgiving Eve game in league history. The Packers managed 244 yards, committed three turnovers and held the ball for just 19:20. They now sit ninth in the NFC, one spot out of the final playoff seed.

stories.text: Watson in concussion protocol, Zeitler hurts ankle
stories.summary: Wide receiver Christian Watson left in the first half after a helmet-to-helmet hit and was evaluated for a concussion. Guard Kevin Zeitler also left with an ankle injury and did not return. Neither had a confirmed return date after the game.

stories.text: Parsons makes his season debut with a sack
stories.summary: Micah Parsons returned from his knee injury on a snap count and sacked Matthew Stafford in the first half. Forbes credits him with one sack, two quarterback hits and a tackle for loss.

stories.text: 241: rushing yards the Packers allowed to the Rams
stories.summary: Blake Corum ran for a career-high 184 yards and a touchdown as Los Angeles held the ball for more than 40 minutes. Green Bay ran 44 plays to the Rams' 71 and was outscored 13-0 in the second half.

stories.text: Packers visit the Saints on Dec. 6
stories.summary: Green Bay plays at New Orleans on Sunday, Dec. 6. Kickoff time and network were not in the reports I found. Watch the run defense and whether Watson clears the protocol.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.headline: Vikings look to bounce back against Falcons

stories.text: Vikings try to shake off a 35-10 loss in Mexico City
stories.summary: Minnesota is 7-3 and third in the NFC North after the 49ers beat them 35-10 on Nov. 22. The Vikings host Atlanta on Sunday with Kirk Cousins facing his former team.

stories.text: Addison out, Murray and Smith limited
stories.summary: Jordan Addison remains out after thumb surgery and is unlikely to play Sunday, per Kevin O'Connell. Kyler Murray (hamstring) and Harrison Smith (thigh) were limited in practice. Tackle Christian Darrisaw left the 49ers game with a shoulder injury.

stories.text: Cousins throws 26 of 38 but a pick-six hurts
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins finished 26 of 38 for 235 yards against San Francisco. Ji'Ayir Brown returned one of his interceptions for a touchdown just before halftime, and the Vikings scored only 10 points.

stories.text: 3: games Kyler Murray has missed with a hamstring strain
stories.summary: Murray has sat out three straight games with a Grade 2 hamstring strain and was limited in practice this week. His return would give Minnesota a second quarterback option.

stories.text: Falcons visit U.S. Bank Stadium on Sunday
stories.summary: Minnesota hosts Atlanta (3-7) on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch Cousins against his old team and how the Vikings cover for Addison.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.headline: Falcons return from bye needing an offense fix

stories.text: Falcons use the bye to rework a struggling offense
stories.summary: Atlanta sits last in the NFC South at 3-7 and heads to Minnesota with a fourth straight loss looming. Coach Kevin Stefanski says every coach self-scouted his area during the bye, with the run game getting a full breakdown. He has not said whether coordinator Tommy Rees will call plays from the box.

stories.text: Bergeron and Hellams miss a second straight practice
stories.summary: Left guard Matthew Bergeron (back) and safety DeMarcco Hellams (foot) did not practice Thursday, along with DB Billy Bowman and WRs Zachariah Branch and Jahan Dotson, all with hamstring injuries. If Hellams cannot go, Sydney Brown and newly signed Jammie Robinson would handle safety. Kyle Hinton is next up behind Bergeron.

stories.text: Gervon Dexter gives Atlanta a real interior pass rush
stories.summary: The fourth-year defensive tackle has 30 pressures and three sacks, and carries a 77.7 pass-rushing grade from PFF. Veteran Za'Darius Smith leads the team with 4.5 sacks. Both will go after Minnesota's offense Sunday.

stories.text: 951: Bijan Robinson's rushing yards rank third in the NFL
stories.summary: Robinson heads into Week 12 with 951 rushing yards, third in the league and close to 1,000. He ran for 143 yards at 6.5 yards a carry against Minnesota last season. The Falcons will lean on him again.

stories.text: At Minnesota, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Atlanta (3-7) visits the 7-3 Vikings at U.S. Bank Stadium. Minnesota lost 35-10 to San Francisco last Sunday night. Watch how Atlanta handles Brian Flores' pressure packages, the point Stefanski stressed this week.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.headline: Panthers lead the South and head to Tampa on MNF

stories.text: Young wins another one late as Panthers take the division lead
stories.summary: Carolina beat Baltimore 35-33 for its second straight win and now sits two games ahead of the rest of the NFC South. Bryce Young drove the offense 55 yards to set up the winning field goal. The Panthers visit Tampa Bay on Monday night with a chance to stretch the lead.

stories.text: McMillan and Okereke sit out Thursday with foot injuries
stories.summary: Receiver Tetairoa McMillan and linebacker Bobby Okereke were projected as non-participants on Thursday's estimated report. Quarterback Bryce Young (foot) was projected as a full participant, and running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) is back from injured reserve. The team has not issued final game designations.

stories.text: Chuba Hubbard keeps the ground game steady
stories.summary: Hubbard carries 831 rushing yards into Monday night. He ran for 120 yards and two touchdowns in his most recent game. Tampa Bay leads the league in rushing offense, so Carolina will need him to keep the ball out of Baker Mayfield's hands.

stories.text: 14: Young's game-winning drives in his career
stories.summary: The 55-yard march against Baltimore, capped by Ryan Fitzgerald's 37-yard field goal with 1:44 left, was the 14th game-winning drive of Young's career. Young threw for 254 yards and two touchdowns in the 35-33 win.

stories.text: At Tampa Bay, Monday 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: Carolina visits Raymond James Stadium on Nov. 30. The Bucs won the Week 7 meeting 43-13 and Carolina has not won in Tampa since 2017. Watch Carolina's run defense under interim coordinator Todd Wash, since Tampa Bay ran for 258 yards in the first meeting.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.headline: Saints get two linemen back as the sacks pile up

stories.text: Saints lose a fifth one-score game as the protection breaks down
stories.summary: New Orleans fell 21-13 at Chicago and sits 3-7, two games behind division-leading Carolina. Tyler Shough went down six times, three of them to Jeffery Simmons. Coach Kellen Moore said Shough is battling but the whole offense has to improve.

stories.text: McCoy and Fuaga return to limited practice
stories.summary: Center Erik McCoy and right tackle Taliese Fuaga practiced on a limited basis Wednesday after missing two games. Seven Saints appeared on the report. The starting line has not finished a game together since Week 1, and tight end Juwan Johnson left the Bears game with a hamstring injury.

stories.text: Chris Olave leads a thin receiver room
stories.summary: Olave has 866 receiving yards, sixth in the NFL, on 68 catches and 101 targets. Devaugh Vele adds 44 catches for 455 yards. The Saints are still looking for more balance after a quiet day from rookie Jordyn Tyson.

stories.text: 6: Sacks Shough took against Chicago
stories.summary: Shough absorbed six sacks in the loss at Soldier Field. He has taken 29 sacks on the season, sixth most among qualified passers. Any plan against Cincinnati starts with keeping him upright.

stories.text: At Cincinnati, Sunday 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: The Saints visit Paycor Stadium to face a Bengals team that lost 22-20 to Washington on Monday night. Cincinnati leads the all-time series 8-7. Watch the offensive line, which could have all five starters together for only the fourth time this season.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.headline: Bucs are out of mulligans before Carolina

stories.text: Bowles says the Bucs have no margin left
stories.summary: Tampa Bay fell 31-21 at Detroit to drop to 3-7, its first loss by more than one score this season. Coach Todd Bowles told reporters the team is out of mulligans. Carolina now leads the division by two games, so Monday night carries real weight.

stories.text: Mayfield practices fully, Winfield and Morrison sit
stories.summary: Quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot, right thumb) was listed as a full participant on Thursday's estimated report. Safety Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) and cornerback Benjamin Morrison (hamstring and back) did not practice. The final report is due Saturday.

stories.text: Rookie Ted Hurst III scores twice in Detroit
stories.summary: Hurst caught five passes for 56 yards and two touchdowns against the Lions, including a 5-yard score with eight seconds left. He gave Mayfield a bright spot in a game with four sacks and a wiped-out 80-yard Bucky Irving touchdown.

stories.text: 159.5: Tampa Bay's rushing yards per game, first in the NFL
stories.summary: The Bucs lead the league on the ground at 159.5 yards a game and rank second against the run at 82.1. Their passing offense ranks 32nd at 143.1. Irving has 893 rushing yards and needs 54 more to reach the franchise top 10.

stories.text: Vs. Carolina, Monday 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: The Bucs host the 5-5 Panthers at Raymond James Stadium on Nov. 30. Tampa Bay won the Week 7 meeting 43-13 and has taken 11 of the last 13 in the series. A win would cut the division gap to one game.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.headline: Cardinals fire DC, QB Beck's back stays sore

stories.text: Cardinals fire Nick Rallis, hand defense to Teryl Austin
stories.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur fired defensive coordinator Nick Rallis the day after a 34-7 loss at Kansas City. Senior defensive assistant Teryl Austin takes over on an interim basis for the final six games. LaFleur said the team needed a fresh voice and that he owns the fix.

stories.text: Beck sits out again with back spasms
stories.summary: Rookie quarterback Carson Beck did not practice Wednesday or Thursday because of back spasms, and Josh Johnson will start again if Beck cannot go. Guard Jon Gaines II (ankle) also sat out and looks set to miss a sixth straight game. Linebackers Karson Sharar (groin) and Cody Simon (calf) were limited Thursday.

stories.text: Trey McBride sees a season-high 14 targets
stories.summary: McBride caught nine passes for 54 yards in the loss to the Chiefs. His 14 targets were the most he has seen this season. Johnson threw for 155 yards and a touchdown in his first start as the fourth different Arizona quarterback in four weeks.

stories.text: 8 of 11: Games where Arizona's defense allowed 30 or more
stories.summary: The Cardinals give up 29.4 points a game, which ranks 31st in the league. The offense scored just 16 points across its last three games. That pairing led LaFleur to change coordinators with six games left.

stories.text: Commanders visit State Farm Stadium Sunday on FOX
stories.summary: Arizona hosts Washington on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch the quarterback decision first, then how Austin's first game calling the defense goes against Jayden Daniels.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.headline: Rams run past Packers on Thanksgiving Eve

stories.text: Rams beat Packers 26-13 and move to 7-4
stories.summary: Los Angeles ran for more than 240 yards on Wednesday night at SoFi Stadium and pushed Green Bay toward the edge of the playoff race. Kyren Williams scored in the second quarter, and the defense forced a fumble and two interceptions. The win gives them a one-game lead in the standings, and the head-to-head tiebreaker makes it effectively two over Green Bay.

stories.text: Line depth thins; Nacua reported out for the season
stories.summary: Guard Steve Avila (hamstring) and tight end Terrance Ferguson (ankle, staying on injured reserve) were ruled out for the Packers game. Center Coleman Shelton (hamstring) is expected to miss four to six weeks. Defensive end Kobie Turner came off injured reserve and lineman Justin Dedich returned to practice. NFL.com reports receiver Puka Nacua had knee surgery and is likely done for the year, though earlier coverage said he stayed off injured reserve.

stories.text: Matthew Stafford finds a rhythm as targets thin out
stories.summary: Through 10 games Stafford has 2,623 passing yards, 19 touchdowns and 10 interceptions, per NFL.com's quarterback index. The index ranks him 14th and says he needs to stay as clean as he was against Arizona in Week 10 with the receiver injuries. He hit Konata Mumpfield for 20 yards on third-and-8 during the Packers game's key second-half touchdown drive.

stories.text: 184: Blake Corum's career-high rushing yards
stories.summary: Corum carried 32 times for 184 yards and a touchdown against Green Bay. It was the most rushing yards by a Rams player since Todd Gurley ran for 208 in 2018. The team piled up a season-high rushing total.

stories.text: Chiefs come to SoFi Thursday night, Dec. 3
stories.summary: The Rams host Kansas City on Thursday, Dec. 3 at 8:15 p.m. ET on Amazon Prime Video, per the original schedule, which the NFL could still flex. Los Angeles then visits the 49ers in Week 14. Watch whether the ground game holds up against a Chiefs defense that will know it is coming.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.headline: 49ers lead NFC, but Purdy's ankle is a question

stories.text: 49ers rout Vikings 35-10 in Mexico City to reach 9-1
stories.summary: San Francisco kept the NFC's top seed with its best start since 2019. Brock Purdy threw three touchdowns, safety Ji'Ayir Brown returned an interception for a score, and the pass rush pressured Kirk Cousins on 15 of 39 dropbacks. Nick Bosa recorded his first sack of the season.

stories.text: Purdy misses two practices with an ankle injury
stories.summary: Purdy did not practice Wednesday or Thursday after hurting his ankle in the second quarter against Minnesota. Kyle Shanahan called it a low ankle issue, not a high ankle sprain. Right tackle Colton McKivitz is reported out for the season with a leg injury. Mike Evans (Achilles) and Dre Greenlaw (neck) were limited Thursday.

stories.text: Mike Evans returns with 109 yards and a touchdown
stories.summary: Evans came back from three games out with Achilles tendinitis and led the 49ers with six catches for 109 yards and a score against Minnesota. George Kittle added two touchdowns on three catches. Christian McCaffrey scored for the eighth straight game.

stories.text: 10-0: Purdy's record in games with a 140 or better rating
stories.summary: Purdy has 10 career games with a passer rating of 140 or higher, the most in NFL history, and San Francisco has won all 10. He went 21 of 26 for 255 yards and three touchdowns against Minnesota while facing the blitz on 77 percent of his dropbacks.

stories.text: Seahawks visit Levi's Stadium Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET
stories.summary: San Francisco hosts Seattle on Sunday, Nov. 29 on FOX. Purdy's practice status Friday and Saturday decides the plan, and the Niners will also find out whether Sam Darnold is back across from them.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.headline: Seahawks ready Darnold for Sunday at San Francisco

stories.text: Darnold practices fully and is set to start at San Francisco
stories.summary: Sam Darnold missed two games with quad and rib injuries, then took full reps Wednesday and Thursday. Mike Macdonald said Darnold was optimistic and the team would decide after practice. Drew Lock won the games in between.

stories.text: Lucas, Reed and Milroe sit; Nwosu added
stories.summary: Tackle Abraham Lucas (ankle), defensive tackle Jarran Reed (toe) and quarterback Jalen Milroe (illness) did not practice Thursday. Linebacker Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) is new to the report, and receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) was limited. Charles Cross went full after being limited Wednesday.

stories.text: Drew Lock is 3-0 as a fill-in starter
stories.summary: Seattle is 4-0 in games Lock has played this season. In the 21-13 win over Las Vegas on Nov. 15 he went 14 of 17 for 240 yards and two touchdowns with no interceptions, but lost two fumbles for his first turnovers as a starter this year.

stories.text: 1,207: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's receiving yards through 10 games
stories.summary: Smith-Njigba had 79 catches and 10 touchdowns entering the bye, and no other receiver had reached 1,000 yards. He accounts for 52 percent of Seattle's receiving yards. He posted 171 yards and a 71-yard score against the Raiders.

stories.text: At the 49ers Sunday, 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Seattle plays at Levi's Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 29 (1:25 p.m. PT), with the NFC West lead on the line against the 9-1 Niners. Watch whether Darnold protects the ball and how the offensive line holds up without Lucas.
